questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

options.text: MOSFETs have lower power dissipation than BJTs.
MOSFETs requires lower area for the process of fabrication than BJTs.
MOSFETs are less noise than BJTs.
MOSFETs can drive a larger current than BJTs due to presence of majority carriers only.

questions.solution:
(a, b, c)
BJTs can supply more current than MOSFETs because the channel formed in the MOS is smaller than the channel in BJTs.
